hooks.command: { FP=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); echo "$FP" | grep -qE '(services/|scoring/|types/music|routes/|db/schema|components/Osmd|hooks/use|parsing/|e2e/|extractTargets|engine\.ts|musicxml\.ts)' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"The file %s was just edited and may affect CODEBASE_SUMMARY.md. Read the changed file and CODEBASE_SUMMARY.md, then make minimal targeted edits to update any outdated sections (types, data flow, API, schema, test structure, rendering, module descriptions). Do not rewrite the entire file — only fix what changed."}}\n' "$FP" || echo '{}'; }
